brands.descEn: Y2K "console chrome" web. Brushed-periwinkle beveled metal panels, a halftone-dotted carbon nav glowing amber, outlined Arial-Black box-art wordmarks over circuit-board hero fields, and a pixel Mario welcome bubble.
